evals.prompt: Create a hero prop from an approved high-poly source for a stated real-time camera. Choose the production branch, preserve source, plan a bake, and deliver low asset/maps plus honest verification. Do not invent a platform budget.
evals.expected_output: Chooses high-to-low branch with coordinate, cage, UV, normal and image gates before export; identifies target checks actually performed.
assertions: High and low source remain separate and coordinate aligned.
Bake output is visually inspected for seams/projection rather than accepted by existence.
Only needed disciplines and supplied budgets are activated.

evals.prompt: A generated character has disconnected intended accessories, stretched shoulder topology and a clothing cage with deleted vertices. Provide bounded recovery through animated delivery; no target editor is available.
evals.expected_output: Preserves source/accessories, repairs deformation planning and obtains a valid category template rather than inventing cage topology; clearly leaves engine acceptance unperformed.
assertions: Disconnected intended parts are not indiscriminately deleted.
Stress-pose review is required beyond normalized weights.
Template/cage uncertainty is surfaced and absence of target import is explicit.
